channel.title: AI Changelog
channel.description: New AI and data science papers, repos, models, tools and news.

item.title: [news] 7 Advanced Python Design Patterns for Data Scientists
item.description: Learn seven design patterns for data science code, from Strategy and Adapter to Command and Proxy, each matched to the pressure it solves, with the Python shape it takes and the caveat that keeps it honest.

item.title: [news] The focus on AI safety disasters ignores everyday harms
item.description: Consider what passes for success in technology policy. An AI company promises that its chatbot will not encourage suicide. A social media platform makes it more difficult for children to buy fentanyl. These are important protections, and they should have existed all along.

item.title: [tool] Proc-CLI – An agent-friendly CLI tool for process and port management
item.description: Launched on Show HN. 16 points and 2 comments so far.

item.title: [news] PaperPilot – Zero-Cloud, Pure-Rust PDF Engine with WASM and MCP
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from github.com. 178 points and 66 comments.

item.title: [repo] Deibler/openskycam
item.description: Record a sky camera around the clock, keep the footage on your own disk, and find what flew past.

item.title: [tool] Freehire, open-source search 3M+ tech jobs from company career boards
item.description: freehire is a filterable, job board aggregator, job tracker, and AI-assisted resume tailoring tool. Saving your skills and preferences changes which jobs appear and how your resume gets tailored.

item.title: [repo] Patch-gg/trompe
item.description: Texture a whole game level from a gray blockout with image models: plan cameras, paint, project, bake. Real shadows, glTF out.

item.title: [repo] nanaism/yomiyasu-mini
item.description: AIが書いた日本語を推敲するスキル yomiyasu を、スキルの大きさに上限がある環境向けに短くしたスキル（SKILL.md 18,000字以下）

item.title: [repo] Cattmonkey/ChaosIntelligence
item.description: 把智能体当函数，把想法写成程序。Agent-native functional language with a CLI, Web IDE, goal-driven bots and live UI. Source-available; no AI training.

item.title: [repo] Cinderubasp/InterviewCopilot-rpocket-team
item.description: EdTech application designed to bridge the gap between learning and landing your dream job

item.title: [paper] A path-following framework on fiber bundle for variational inequalities
item.description: A path-following framework on a fixed-point fiber bundle achieves global linear convergence for variational inequalities with continuous mappings over polytopes without monotonicity assumptions.

item.title: [paper] The fixed-point bundle method over product-of-simplex domains arising from game equilibria
item.description: A fixed-point bundle framework extended to product-of-simplex domains via geometric equivalence yields globally convergent path-following algorithms for Nash equilibrium computation.

item.title: [paper] Does LeWorldModel Preserve Local Action Geometry?
item.description: Pretrained LeWorldModel's reproduction of small action effects is evaluated via Gram matrices across perturbation scales, showing scale-dependent sensitivity differences and higher errors than environment references.

item.title: [paper] MMVistaReason: Toward Open-Data and Post-Training Recipes for Multimodal Reasoning
item.description: MMVistaReason improves open multimodal reasoning through structured data construction, difficulty-aware distillation, and specialized reinforcement learning integration.

item.title: [paper] DraMaze: A Multi-Agent Pipeline with Future-Aware Memory for Diverse Microdrama Script Generation
item.description: DraMaze improves long-form microdrama script generation by using evolutionary tree search guided by trope memory and backward narrative dependency trees to enhance plot diversity and coherence.

item.title: [paper] Every Weight Is a Path of Shared Discrete Decisions
item.description: TWIG represents neural network weights as shared discrete decision paths, unifying compression methods and enabling efficient fixed-weight circuits with optimized discrete choices.

item.title: [paper] Building Auditable AI Text Detectors with Sparse Autoencoders
item.description: A pipeline using sparse autoencoders extracts interpretable linguistic features from neural detectors, yielding more accurate and explainable AI-generated text classification.

item.title: [paper] TenetBench: A Clause-Anchored Russian Corpus for Evaluating Language Models against Professional Codes of Ethics
item.description: TenetBench evaluates whether language models adhere to professional ethical codes by pairing conflicting requests with benign equivalents, revealing frequent unflagged violations across most tested models.

item.title: [repo] Koustubh12345/TenSeiAi
item.description: From-scratch Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model and offline AI engine in pure Python & NumPy. Zero PyTorch. Zero GGUF.

item.title: [repo] zickrian/isle
item.description: A notch-style island for GNOME with an AI assistant that installs and fixes things, Claude Code and Codex approvals from the notch, music with synced lyrics, notifications, a focus timer, tasks and a clipboard shelf.

item.title: [tool] Phonon
item.description: Text-to-speech that runs in your browser

item.title: [paper] RoboJudge: Multimodal Language Models as Judges for Embodied Video Generation
item.description: Researchers introduce a benchmark and training dataset to evaluate multimodal language models as judges of physically valid, instruction-aligned embodied video generation, yielding a fine-tuned 9B judge with high human agreement.

item.title: [paper] DuoLM: Fast and Effective Personalized Recommendation with Language Models
item.description: DuoLM accelerates personalized recommendation by combining a compact encoder and ranker with optimized inference, achieving high throughput with minimal quality loss.

item.title: [paper] MultiAgent-OPD: End-to-End Training of Hierarchical Multi-Agent Systems with On-Policy Distillation
item.description: MultiAgent-OPD jointly trains a hierarchical multi-agent team via on-policy distillation and reinforcement learning, using a frozen teacher for local process supervision to improve end-to-end performance across multiple datasets.

item.title: [paper] Co-adaptive Rule Routing and Constraining for Structured Knowledge Retrieval
item.description: CoRE jointly learns reasoning rules and constrained evidence retrieval through alternating reinforcement and contrastive learning without predefined query-rule supervision.

item.title: [model] MemTensor/MemT-1.0-Nano
item.description: Text generation model from MemTensor. 30.3k downloads and 138 likes so far.

item.title: [paper] SliderEdit++: Improved Slider Trajectories in Instruction-Based Image Editing
item.description: SlideBench benchmarks continuous image editing and SliderEdit++ improves slider reliability via trajectory regularization and disentanglement for smoother, faster control.

item.title: [tool] Free AI Detector
item.description: Free, no-signup AI detector with sentence-level analysis.

item.title: [news] OpenAI and Anthropic cut their LLM prices by up to 80% within a few months. Why?
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from minimaxir.com. 216 points and 246 comments.

item.title: [repo] boyuchengz/canvas-mcp
item.description: Read-only MCP server that connects Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants to Canvas LMS.

item.title: [news] Seam Cutter
item.description: Tool: Seam Cutter I built this weird and very specific cropping tool - it lets you create a horizontal or vertical cut across an image, then slide the two sides relative to each other. Effectively it lets you crop out a section in the middle of an image.

item.title: [repo] jadezane6634-ops/dsh-purge-flash
item.description: DSH 破甲插件：token 级重试环 + 十片按需叶子（含邻近交付）+ 分级 prefill + 拒答阶梯 L0–L3 + finish_reason 四路分流 + 请求体级整形。零宿主补丁，188 项测试 / 56 条探针。

item.title: [tool] ADRs for AI – Deliberation records for human–AI work, versioned in Git
item.description: Why is this worth your time?

item.title: [repo] KhulekanisiyandaMchunu/llm-trading-arena
item.description: Live trading arena for LLM agents: public reasoning, real market data, virtual capital

item.title: [paper] The Language of Instruction: Genre and Generative AI
item.description: This article argues that instruction-fine-tuned language models should be understood as implementing a genre, what is proposed as the instructional-conversational genre.

item.title: [paper] Separating Thinking from Spelling for Efficient Generative Recommendation
item.description: Generative recommenders retrieve items by writing their semantic IDs (SIDs) code by code under trie-constrained beam search, an approach now deployed on large web platforms.

item.title: [paper] SceneBloom: Agentic Indoor Environment Generation with Realistic and Diverse Layouts for Embodied Learning
item.description: Training generalizable embodied agents requires realistic, varied, and simulation-ready indoor environments. Language-guided methods support semantic planning and object-level reasoning, but precise spatial grounding remains difficult.

item.title: [paper] UniAction: Unified Action Conditioning for World Models
item.description: Actions that condition world models are highly heterogeneous, and thus existing action-conditioned world models are typically built for individual action types, fragmenting already limited action-annotated data across separate models.

item.title: [paper] FlexGlue: Sparse-to-Dense Feature Matching and Visual Disambiguation
item.description: To estimate correspondences across images, existing approaches match either sparse interest points, which is highly efficient but limited by repeatability, or dense pixel grids, which is robust but expensive.

item.title: [paper] RobustRLlib: A Unified Library and Benchmark for Robust Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
item.description: Robust reinforcement learning (RL) is critical for reliable real-world deployment, where policies may fail under diverse shifts and disruptions.

item.title: [paper] DexPort: A Hand-Held Skill Interface for Dexterous Hand Data Collection
item.description: Collecting high-quality demonstrations remains a central bottleneck for learning dexterous manipulation. Teleoperation records executable robot actions, but it requires a complete robot setup and places the burden of coordinating many finger joints on the operator.

item.title: [paper] MiD-VLM: Detecting and Grounding Global Semantic Misinformation in Image-Caption Pairs
item.description: Semantic misinformation can arise when an authentic image is paired with a caption that changes or distorts its narrative.

item.title: [paper] ViT-H: Generative Video-To-Humanoid Control with Motion Tracking Feedback
item.description: Learning humanoid control from monocular human videos offers a scalable way to acquire diverse whole-body behaviors.

item.title: [paper] Flownomaly: Single-Step Conditional-Mean Recovery for Few-Shot Anomaly Detection
item.description: Few-shot industrial anomaly detection requires modeling category-specific normality from only a handful of defect-free images. Common approaches tie inference to stored exemplars, impose rigid linear structure, or risk reproducing anomalous content.

item.title: [paper] Measure Before You Train: Typed Decision Models vs. a Classical Baseline vs. a Generative LLM for Routing a Personal Multilingual Inbox
item.description: Personal email agents decide, for every message, what it is, whether it is urgent, whether to draft a reply, create a task, or ignore it. Their error rate is rarely measured: the stored labels were written by the system itself.

item.title: [paper] Where Rounding Happens Matters: Rounding-Location Alignment Stabilizes LLM Reinforcement Learning
item.description: Reinforcement learning for large language models often uses separate systems for inference and training. Even with identical weights and BF16 tensors, implementation differences can make an intended on-policy update off-policy and destabilize training.

item.title: [paper] Beyond Discrete Tokens: Preserving Numerical Continuity in Medical Vision-Language Models
item.description: Objective: To develop a unified vision-language model for prompt-conditioned quantitative ultrasound measurement that addresses the mismatch between continuous measurement targets and discrete token-based numerical prediction.

item.title: [paper] Monetizing Intelligence: Advertising and Subscription Design on LLM Platforms
item.description: Large language model (LLM) platforms introducing advertising must decide how much capability ad revenue should fund and what consumers should pay to avoid ads.

item.title: [paper] Knowledge Distillation across Item and Code Spaces for Parallel Generative Recommendation
item.description: Generative recommendation with semantic IDs represents each item as a sequence of discrete codes derived from its semantic representation and predicts these codes to generate recommendations.

item.title: [paper] If at First You Don't Succeed, Backtrack: Lightweight Recovery for Frozen VLAs
item.description: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models perform well on robotic manipulation, yet remain brittle once their own actions carry them into states their training data barely covers.

item.title: [paper] Learning Positive Linear Combinations of ReLUs in Fully Polynomial Time
item.description: We study the fundamental problem of PAC learning positive linear combinations of $k$ arbitrary ReLU activations on $\mathbb{R}^d$ with respect to the Gaussian distribution, in $L_2$ loss. We give the first fully-polynomial time algorithm for this learning task.

item.title: [paper] Yalda-Embedding: Open Development of a Competitive Persian Retrieval Model
item.description: Despite advances in multilingual text representations, effective dense retrieval for Persian remains constrained by the limited availability of language-specific training resources and compact embedding models.

item.title: [paper] STROKE: Simple Sparse Structural Occlusions for Black-Box Adversarial Attacks
item.description: We introduce STROKE, a query-efficient score-based black-box adversarial attack that constructs perturbations from simple oriented rectangular occlusions. STROKE optimizes these perturbations through a lightweight greedy add-and-refine procedure.

item.title: [paper] ZENO: Nonlinear filtering with Zakai Equation Neural Operators
item.description: State inference and parameter learning for nonlinear filters is a core computation for scientific machine learning with varied applications in engineering and neuroscience.

item.title: [paper] Adaptive Frequency Threshold Byte Pair Encoding for Mixed Natural Language and Structured Symbolic Corpora
item.description: Modern language models rely on subwording tokenization to define the discrete units of input processing, typically using methods like Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) that treat whitespace as a fixed semantic boundary.

item.title: [paper] SemantEq: Faithful Bidirectional Equivalence of Formal Statements
item.description: Statement autoformalization translates mathematics from natural language into a proof assistant such as Lean 4, and models now do it at scale.

item.title: [paper] A Tutorial on Physics Constrained Machine Learning for Hybrid Modeling, Optimization, and Control
item.description: Physics-constrained machine learning (PCML) integrates domain knowledge, first-principles, and physical constraints into AI/ML models.

item.title: [paper] Recommender regret for improving regularised RL estimation with bandits and MCTS
item.description: Regularised reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms rely on estimators, like Monte Carlo tree search or one-step look-ahead, to provide policy, value, or Q-value estimates in training and inference.

item.title: [paper] LoCA: Enabling Multi-Modality in Geospatial Location Encoders
item.description: LoCA is a two-stage pipeline that trains co-aligned multimodal image encoders and uses them as high-rank targets to train location and metadata encoders via contrastive learning, outperforming existing methods across diverse geospatial tasks.

item.title: [paper] Green Code or Costly Code? Evaluating the Energy Costs of Iterative LLM-Based Code Optimizations
item.description: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to optimize code for performance. This practice often assumes that improvements in execution speed naturally translate into overall lower energy consumption.

item.title: [paper] Closing the Modality Gap via Simplex-Constrained Representations
item.description: While multimodal contrastive models like CLIP and CLAP successfully learn shared representations, their embeddings typically exhibit a persistent \emph{modality gap}.

item.title: [paper] When Human Corrections Travel: Safety in Federated VLA Adaptation
item.description: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can adapt to local human intervention, while federated learning can combine distributed robot experience without pooling raw records.

item.title: [paper] Reinforcement Learning with Multi-Step Transition Predictions: A Bellman Theory
item.description: Multi-step predictions of future transition realizations can improve reinforcement learning, but their value remains difficult to quantify.

item.title: [paper] VTRL-Med: Progressive Visual Refinement with Topology-Guided Regularization for Medical Image Clustering
item.description: Deep clustering offers a promising approach for analyzing large unlabeled medical image datasets, yet prevailing methods still face two limitations: they may neglect class-agnostic structural priors that capture object boundaries and regions, and they do not explicitly encode…

item.title: [paper] NgramRL: Accelerating RL Post-Training for Structured Generation via Rollout-Aware N-gram Speculative Decoding
item.description: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but its cost is dominated by autoregressive rollout generation, which can exceed 70% of training time.

item.title: [paper] Multimodal Generative AI Assists Comprehensive Echocardiographic Interpretation
item.description: Echocardiography is the cornerstone of cardiovascular diagnostics, yet its global utility is constrained by a critical shortage of experienced interpreters.

item.title: [paper] Advancing SVD-based LLM Compression via Layer-Wise Error Model Search
item.description: Low-rank SVD-based compression offers a powerful strategy to reduce the computational costs of LLMs.

item.title: [paper] Trusting the Tool: Asymmetric Deference of LLM Vulnerability Auditors to Static-Analysis Evidence
item.description: Pipelines that combine large language models (LLMs) with static analysis let the model consume the analyser's output as evidence, but whether the model distinguishes true from false evidence, and whether its scrutiny depends on what the evidence claims, has not been measured.

item.title: [paper] Do "True" and "False" Add Up to One? Complement Consistency in LLM-Agent Opinion Simulations
item.description: In LLM-agent opinion simulations, each agent reports the probability that a claim is true after seeing its own previous probability and the probabilities reported by its neighbors, and that number becomes its state in the next round.

item.title: [paper] J-Comm: Jacobian-Guided Latent Communication between LLM Agents
item.description: Latent communication requires both an effective continuous reasoning process and an interface through which an external model can leverage its intermediate computation. We present J-Comm, a framework comprising two core components.

item.title: [paper] From Deliberately Constructed Systemic Representations of the World of Activity to Dialogue: A Five-Level Communication Architecture for Strong Language-Based ASI
item.description: This paper proposes a five-level organization of message formation and understanding within thinking and activity in which ASI participates.

item.title: [paper] Interpretable sparse fine-tuning with TopKLoRA enables faithful circuit discovery
item.description: Fine-tuning on datasets of unknown origin can create a backdoor in the trained model when the data includes poisoned examples. Difficult to localise and remove, backdoors can persist through safety training.

item.title: [paper] PoKER: A Probability of Kill Estimation Rate Model for Air-to-Air Missiles Using Machine Learning on Stochastic Targets
item.description: This work introduces PoKER, a novel probabilistic model engineered to optimize missile launch effectiveness in air-to-air scenarios, specifically within Beyond Visual Range (BVR) air combat.

item.title: [paper] A Foundation Model for Policy In-Context Longitudinal Causal Effect Estimation
item.description: Longitudinal causal effect estimation is complicated by time-varying confounding and treatment-confounder feedback loops.

item.title: [paper] Sustainability of TSFM Deployment and Pretraining: From Carbon Footprint Analysis to Mitigation via Pruning
item.description: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) offer strong zero-shot forecasting capabilities, but their high pretraining cost raises a practical sustainability question: does this upfront investment pay off over a full deployment lifecycle, compared to supervised standalone models…

item.title: [paper] Regularised RL improves sim-to-real transfer
item.description: Regularised reinforcement learning (RL) has provable robustness guarantees that should ease the transfer of policies from simulation to robots, known as sim-to-real.

item.title: [paper] Singular Geometry of Low-Rank Adaptation
item.description: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is now a standard approach to parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large neural networks.

item.title: [paper] Near-Optimal List Replicability from Littlestone Dimension
item.description: We study the list replicability number in the realizable PAC learning framework and prove that every concept class $H$ over a countable domain with Littlestone dimension $d$ and dual VC dimension $v^*$ satisfies \[ \mathrm{LR}(H)\leq 2^{O(d\min\{\log d,v^*\})}.

item.title: [paper] Reimagining Enterprise RAG for Multi-Agent Systems: A Knowledge Layer That Organizes Before It Retrieves
item.description: Enterprises are deploying agentic AI across the software development lifecycle, and they need the behavioral logic of the systems they act on, not stakeholder documentation.

item.title: [paper] Mixed Engression: Distributional Regression for Multivariate Mixed-Type Responses
item.description: Estimating the conditional distribution of multivariate responses with continuous and binary components requires capturing their dependence, respecting their different supports, and accommodating potentially heavy-tailed continuous outcomes.

item.title: [paper] Neural LoFi with Backward Coupling: A Spectral Theory of Cross-Layer Feature Learning
item.description: During joint training, backpropagation allows later layers to reshape earlier representations, a feedback mechanism absent from purely layer-wise learning.

item.title: [paper] OpenStripe supports open-set identification and spatial stripe profiling in wild Amur tigers
item.description: Non-invasive camera-trap monitoring of endangered wildlife requires open-set individual identification---grouping field images into identities without predefined classes or a known population size---yet pose deformation and cluttered backgrounds complicate image comparison.

item.title: [paper] Communicating with the Entire Population: Machine Translation of Emergency Alerts and Warnings
item.description: It is essential that we communicate with the entirety of an affected population during a crisis, including those who do not speak a region's dominant language(s).

item.title: [paper] SPOOK: Sparse Pixel Optimization for Off-Manifold Knowledge in Vision Encoders
item.description: Modern vision encoders are widely used as semantic representations, but the relationship between embedding similarity and human-visible semantics can become unclear far from the natural-image manifold.

item.title: [paper] On the Limits of Sparse Linear Model with Shuffled Differential Privacy
item.description: Sparse linear regression is a fundamental problem in high-dimensional statistics, and its private counterparts leave a large gap between the central and the local model of differential privacy.

item.title: [paper] KrishokTech: A Bengali Agricultural Advisory System with Explicit Authorization Controls
item.description: For agricultural advisory, generating an answer is only part of the problem: the system must also control unsafe requests, work with limited connectivity, and accommodate changing guidance.

item.title: [paper] Sounding Surgical Instrument Localisation through Audio-Visual Correspondence
item.description: Surgical scene understanding is a prerequisite for context-aware and intelligent systems in the operating room. Current methods rely mostly on visual data, while acoustic sensing has shown potential to provide complementary information on surgical activity.

item.title: [paper] HarnessMM: Recursive Self-Improvement for Harness Token Efficiency
item.description: Agent harnesses repeatedly invoke reasoning after tool feedback, even when an earlier call has already fixed the next action.

item.title: [paper] U-NeXt: General-purpose event detection for neonatal EEG
item.description: We developed U-NeXt, a general framework for neonatal electroencephalography (EEG) event detection based on semantic segmentation. Its convolutional encoder-decoder directly segments individual channels using long input segments to preserve temporal context.

item.title: [paper] Frontier-OPD: Discovering the Edge of Agent Capability and Teaching Agents to Go Beyond
item.description: On-policy distillation aligns teacher feedback with a student's current behavior, yet acquiring useful supervision for multi-turn agents requires identifying both where guidance is needed and whether the student can sustain the interaction afterward.

item.title: [paper] Multiplicative vs. Additive State Coupling in Learned Optimizer Schedules
item.description: We learn schedules for a continuous penalty relaxation of MAX-CUT by backpropagating through an unrolled classical solver. A state-blind schedule generalizes to instances substantially larger than those used for training.

item.title: [paper] CompMVR: Compression-Aware Multi-View Restoration Using Diffusion Models for Geometrically Consistent 3D Reconstruction
item.description: Real-world 3D reconstruction pipelines often rely on multi-view images degraded by lossy compression. While compression artifacts have been extensively studied in single-image or video restoration, their impact on multi-view geometry remains largely overlooked.

item.title: [paper] CARES: Coverage-Aware Replay Exemplar Selection for Continual Learning
item.description: Replay-based Continual Learning mitigates catastrophic forgetting by keeping a buffer of past samples, making buffer composition critical under a fixed memory budget.

item.title: [paper] ParaTaxe: a Suite of Tools for Processing and Publishing Multi-parallel Corpora
item.description: Over the past fifteen years, digital tools for parallelizing and aligning textual corpora have developed significantly within the field of digital humanities. Several projects and software tools have been created to compare different translations or versions of texts.

item.title: [paper] Consommé: Conditioned Token Merging for Split Inference
item.description: Split inference partitions a Vision Transformer between a resource-constrained edge device and a server. However, transmitting intermediate tokens across the communication channel is costly. Deploying fine-tuned backbones to every endpoint becomes expensive as well.

item.title: [paper] SREdit: Scene Response Guided Appearance Editing for Projection Mapping
item.description: Projection-based appearance editing changes selected visual attributes of a physical object through projection mapping (PM).

item.title: [paper] Generalization properties of the token perceptron: the role of embedding and vocabulary
item.description: Large language models are trained to predict tokens from a finite vocabulary, each represented by a vector in a $d$-dimensional embedding space. Therefore, token prediction is a classification problem whose classes have a geometry determined by the embedding.

item.title: [paper] Structure and Exact Certification of Nonnegative Tensor Decompositions
item.description: We study the structure and exact certification of nonnegative tensor decompositions supplied through rational factor matrices. Every failure of minimality or essential uniqueness contains an irreducible positive exchange between $p$ supplied terms and $q$ competing terms.

item.title: [paper] Video-MemComp: Taylor-Guided Sensitivity-Aware Memory Management for Streaming Video Understanding
item.description: The rapid growth of video data has created an urgent need for efficient video understanding systems that can handle long and continuous visual inputs, posing significant challenges for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) due to severe memory bottlenecks.

item.title: [paper] Every Edge Needs a Quote: Building a Quote-Grounded Knowledge Graph of Healthcare Software Adoption with Language-Model Agents
item.description: Hospitals regularly buy software that clinicians and patients depend on. Because these purchases are costly, hard to reverse and can affect patient care, buyers look for evidence of which peer institutions already use a product and which systems it connects to.

item.title: [paper] AI Alignment for Digital Democracy: Fairer Voters Representation against LLM Biases
item.description: AI representation is emerging in digital democracy, assisting in voter emulation and decision-making.

item.title: [paper] Deep Learning-Based Prediction of HER2 Status from Whole-Brain MRI in Breast Cancer Brain Metastases
item.description: Purpose: Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) status is a key biomarker relevant for prognostication and treatment decision making in metastatic breast cancer.

item.title: [paper] Direction-Aware Token Credit Assignment with Reward-Model Gradients
item.description: GRPO shares a response-level advantage across tokens, leaving unresolved how strongly each token should contribute to learning.

item.title: [paper] On-Policy Self-Training: Data-Free Self-Improvement in Large Language Models
item.description: Foundation models can self-improve across text and vision tasks by generating synthetic questions and reasoning traces guided only by high-level topics, without external supervision.

item.title: [paper] SCDM-HTD: Spectral-Wise Conditional Diffusion Model for Hyperspectral Target Detection
item.description: Hyperspectral target detection (HTD) aims to locate and recognize objects at a fine-grained scale, playing a pivotal role in remote sensing.

item.title: [paper] Clean-label Poisoning Attack and Defense Game for Federated Learning in Vehicular Networks
item.description: This paper studies interactions between clean-label poisoning attack and defense in vehicular networks using federated learning (FL).

item.title: [paper] ARENA: Active Region attENtion Aggregation for interpretable solar flare prediction
item.description: Predicting solar flares is a challenging space-weather forecasting problem with potentially significant impacts on Earth's upper atmosphere, including disruptions to radio communications.

item.title: [paper] Semantic Representation for Agentic Self-Play in Automated Laboratories
item.description: Navigating complex, high-dimensional biological search spaces necessitates scalable physical and computational intelligence to explore beyond local optima through iterative self-play across ideation, experimentation, and automation.

item.title: [paper] Sparse Bayesian Neural Networks via Sticky Piecewise Deterministic Markov Processes
item.description: There is growing evidence that the performance of a neural network depends largely on a small subset of its weights, which are typically identified by training a dense network and pruning it afterwards.

item.title: [paper] ActionRAG: Evidence-Refining Graph Diffusion for Long-Term Memory in LLM Agents
item.description: LLM agents need long-term memory that can recover precise and mutually consistent evidence from growing interaction histories, particularly when answers depend on relations among facts rather than isolated semantic matches.

item.title: [paper] On the Identifiability of Hybrid Deep Generative Models: Meta-Learning as a Solution
item.description: The interest in leveraging physics-based inductive bias in deep learning has resulted in recent development of hybrid deep generative models (hybrid-DGMs) that integrate known physics-based mathematical expressions in neural generative models.

item.title: [paper] Adaptive World-Models for Anomaly Recognition (AWARE): A Framework for Robot Dynamics Prediction and Introspection
item.description: Unrecognized anomalies in critical infrastructure can rapidly cascade into catastrophic physical or operational failures.

item.title: [paper] Strongly Adaptive Online Learning with Time-Varying Movement Costs
item.description: We study strongly adaptive regret for Online Convex Optimization (OCO) with time-varying movement costs, a setting that evaluates a learner's performance over arbitrary sub-intervals.

item.title: [paper] Agentic Hazard Mapper: Emulating Expert Map-Making with AI Agents for Risk Communication
item.description: Hazard maps are essential tools for public risk communication, preparedness, and evacuation planning, yet effective cartographic design is not always ensured due to limited access to cartographic expertise across local governments and communities.

item.title: [paper] Cross-Architectural Feature Fusion for Coronary Artery Stenosis Detection in X-ray Angiography
item.description: Coronary artery disease remains a leading cause of mortality, with stenosis detection from invasive X-ray Coronary Angiography (XCA) critical for diagnosis. Manual interpretation is time-consuming, subjective, and variable, especially under low contrast and vessel overlap.

item.title: [paper] Internal Discrepancy for Contrastive Learning: Generalization Bounds and Downstream Behaviors
item.description: Contrastive learning has emerged as a popular paradigm for training representation models.

item.title: [paper] CityLift: Compositional 3D Urban Generation from a Single Image
item.description: Generating editable 3D urban scenes from a single image requires detailed building assets with a coherent spatial arrangement. Occlusion and perspective ambiguity make it difficult to infer complete building geometry together with consistent relative scales and positions.

item.title: [paper] PlayerEmbed: Learning Behavioral Fingerprint Representations from Raw Input Sequences
item.description: Raw player input sequences in video games contain fine-grained behavior, but are high-dimensional and noisy, which makes large-scale analytics challenging.

item.title: [paper] The Butterfly Defects: Tracing Cooperation in LLM Agent Networks
item.description: As large language models (LLMs) increasingly operate as interconnected agents, a fundamental question emerges: does individual cooperation translate into collective cooperation?

item.title: [paper] Ontology-Guided Knowledge Graph Construction from Structured Metadata and Climate Science Publications
item.description: The rapid expansion of scientific literature far outpaces the speed of manual curation, creating a fundamental bottleneck in extracting structured knowledge from scientific texts.

item.title: [paper] Cross-Scenario Controller Parameter Transformation from Real-World Driving Data through Flow Matching
item.description: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems have become increasingly widespread, aiming to support drivers, reduce workload, and improve traffic safety. However, many systems are rarely used because their behavior feels unnatural and does not match individual driving behavior.

item.title: [paper] Are Textual Residuals Truly Complementary? Learning Visual Complements under Semantic Superposition for Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification
item.description: Text-enhanced visible-infrared person re-identification (VI-ReID) exploits textual descriptions to compensate for appearance cues that are weak or unavailable under infrared imaging.

item.title: [paper] Score-Preserving Continual Lasso under Task Shift
item.description: Continual learning (CL) aims to learn from sequential tasks while mitigating catastrophic forgetting when historical data are no longer accessible.

item.title: [paper] CounselPlex: A Stressor-Aware Full-Duplex Counseling Model
item.description: Full-duplex speech models can listen and speak at the same time, enabling natural, low-latency interaction. In counseling, however, these models often focus on the latest utterance and lose track of the seeker's underlying problem. We call this failure Stressor Blindness.

item.title: [paper] SP-Guide: Enhancing Aerial Vision-Language Navigation with Spatial Priors
item.description: Aerial vision-language navigation (AVLN) requires a UAV to reach a language-described target from partial egocentric observations while reasoning over large outdoor scenes.

item.title: [paper] Natural Language Autoencoders Identify Without Explaining
item.description: Natural Language Autoencoders (NLAs) express a model's internal activations in the form of readable text.

item.title: [paper] Conditional Neural Processes for Self-Supervised Goal Discovery in Action Imitation
item.description: Inspired by infants' ability to learn novel tasks by imitating others, in this work we evaluate to what extent Conditional Neural Processes can autonomously learn representations of actions that are informative about their underlying goal.

item.title: [paper] When is more search useful? An Empirical Study of Search Utility in Quality-Aware Decoding for Machine Translation
item.description: Quality-Aware Decoding (QAD) improves machine translation through test-time scaling, generating multiple candidate translations and selecting the final output with a quality-aware decoder.

item.title: [paper] Probing the limits of forward screening and inverse design of crystal materials
item.description: Crystal materials are designed either by screening known crystals for a target property or by generating new crystals with that property. Both routes are judged against public databases of known crystals, but these databases name the same crystal differently.

item.title: [paper] Retiming Robot Demonstrations with a Learned Speed Prior
item.description: The pace of a robot demonstration is often determined by the teleoperator rather than by the task itself.

item.title: [paper] EMG Tokenization Preserves Movement Information at a Fraction of the Bitrate
item.description: Wireless electromyography (EMG) interfaces must balance electrode coverage against transmission bandwidth. Here, we show that compact EMG tokens substantially reduce payload while retaining information for three-dimensional hand-pose decoding.

item.title: [paper] Robust Offset-Free Lane-Keeping Control Framework for Vision-Only Automated Vehicles
item.description: Achieving accurate, real-time lane-keeping control during high-speed cornering on large-curvature roads while ensuring robust vehicle stability is a critical challenge in autonomous driving.

item.title: [paper] Do Language Models Trust Their Own Justifications? A Study on Functional Consistency
item.description: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been widely adopted in text classification tasks, where they not only output class predictions but also generate explanations that highlight the tokens deemed most relevant for reaching the predicted label.

item.title: [paper] The Answer Knows Where to Look: Zooming before MLLMs Answer under Visual-Token Budgets
item.description: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) read images through visual tokens, and under the small per-image budgets that efficient deployment requires, the fine text of documents, charts and infographics becomes illegible.

item.title: [paper] SemGeo-Gen: Unsupervised Generation of Approximate Cross-Instance Semantic-Geometric Correspondences
item.description: We introduce SemGeo-Gen, an unsupervised method for generating approximate cross-instance semantic-geometric supervision from weakly aligned 3D object collections.

item.title: [paper] WiMoT: Replay-Free Continual Wi-Fi Sensing via Moment Transport
item.description: Continual Wi-Fi sensing must balance plasticity, learning new rooms or users, against stability, keeping earlier ones, yet nodes often cannot retain channel state information (CSI) for privacy and storage reasons.

item.title: [paper] DT-JEPA: Learning to Predict Future Representations for Decision-Making
item.description: Decision Transformer (DT) has demonstrated strong performance in various offline reinforcement learning (RL) tasks by conditioning action generation on expected future returns and historical trajectories.

item.title: [paper] WL-SeqVAE: Sequence-Based Graph Generation Using Variational Autoencoders and Weisfeiler-Leman Colors
item.description: In this paper, we introduce WL-SeqVAE, a sequence-based variational autoencoder for generating graphs.

item.title: [paper] Computational imaging through turbid, bubbly and flowing water near the telescope
item.description: Cameras in the surf zone or behind ship wakes look through turbid, bubbly, moving water close to the lens, yet restoration networks are usually scored only on displayed images.

item.title: [paper] InferSlice: A Reference Architecture for SLO-driven LLM Inference over a Telco Wide-Area Network
item.description: LLM inference is increasingly deployed as a core service for enterprise and interactive applications, but sovereignty, compliance, latency and resource-locality requirements can limit the suitability of centralised cloud deployments.

item.title: [paper] Residual Expert Routing for Text-Only Domain Adaptation of Factorized Transducer ASR
item.description: Fine-tuning the non-blank predictor of a factorized transducer on target-domain text improves recognition on that domain but degrades performance on the source domain.

item.title: [paper] Can AI Agents Help Robotic Engineers? Lessons from Two Focus Days in Industry
item.description: Software developers increasingly use AI agents that execute multi-step programming tasks on their own.

item.title: [paper] EditJev: System One Routing for Image Editing Models
item.description: Instruction-based image editing models exhibit pronounced sample-specific performance variation: different models can produce substantially different results for the same source image and editing instruction, and the best-performing model often varies across requests.

item.title: [paper] The Standard Deviation in VICReg Buys a Safety Margin
item.description: VICReg prevents collapse with a hinge on the standard deviation of each embedding dimension, and its authors argue from the gradient that a hinge on the variance would fail. To our knowledge, this claim has not been tested experimentally.

item.title: [paper] Interpretable Singing Emotion Recognition Using Acoustic and Vocal Technique Features
item.description: Singing emotion recognition relies predominantly on deep learning models that achieve strong performance but offer limited insight into the vocal characteristics driving emotion, of- ten overlooking the singing voice as a distinct signal.

item.title: [paper] Acquisition for Spherical-Linear Bayesian Optimization on the Cube
item.description: Recent work demonstrated that executing Bayesian Optimization (BO) using simply a linear surrogate with a clever transformation is enough to approximate the performance of the standard Gaussian-Process (GP) based version on high-dimensional test functions.

item.title: [paper] LGMT: A Tool for Testing the Logical Reasoning Reliability of LLMs
item.description: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly serve as reasoning components in modern software systems, yet a model that answers a logical query correctly can contradict itself when the same problem is restated in an equivalent form.

item.title: [paper] What Transfers Across Protein Pockets? Experience Reuse in Molecular Optimization for Agentic Structure-Based Drug Design
item.description: LLM agents optimize a ligand in a protein pocket by editing it step by step and docking each edit.

item.title: [paper] Earth embeddings are decomposable records of the land surface
item.description: Ecological monitoring, carbon accounting and biodiversity assessment increasingly rely on annual Earth embeddings--learned vectors that compress a year of satellite observation for every ten-meter pixel on Earth, consumed in place of the imagery itself.

item.title: [paper] From archive to resource: bringing legacy data back to life at scale with large language models
item.description: Pharmaceutical companies maintain vast archives of legacy preclinical study reports that contain study-context details, such as fasting, anesthesia, and laboratory instrumentation, that are rarely captured in structured data formats, yet they can correlate with clinical…
